title: Chapter 440 - 440 Spending A Billion, Earning Five Trillion!
content:
Chapter 440 - 440 Spending A Billion, Earning Five Trillion!

Chapter 440 - 440 Spending a Billion, Earning Five Trillion!

440 Spending a Billion, Earning Five Trillion!

Feng Zhixiang did not care about Lin Fan’s words at all. He continued to laugh excitedly.

After a while…

“Professor Lin, the Jiangbei branch of the Institute of Science is ready. I wonder if you have time to come over and give us some guidance?”

His words were filled with anticipation.

Even though Feng Zhixiang had seen Lin Fan a few times, he only took away Lin Fan’s products each time and never got to chat much with him.

Of course, Feng Zhixiang knew that even if he chatted with Lin Fan, he probably would not be able to get anything out of it.

However, if Lin Fan was willing to go to the Institute of Science, it would be completely different.

There were many academicians there.

They were knowledgeable and could talk to Lin Fan about many things.

In addition, this was something that the academicians had been looking forward to.

Lin Fan understood what Feng Zhixiang was thinking.

He was also willing to give some pointers to the academicians.

This was because, in Lin Fan’s eyes, it was this group of people that allowed the people of Hua Nation to live stable, safe, and happy lives.

Lin Fan felt that he did not have much to do today anyway.

Thus, he said, “Then I’ll go over later.”

“Really? That’s great!” Feng Zhixiang shouted excitedly.

Lin Fan heard the cheers from the other end of the phone.

After hanging up, Lin Fan could not help but smile and shake his head.

Then, he turned his attention back to the 200,000 normal red packets.

“Collect them all!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 2 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received ten yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a one yuan critical hit card.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 10% shares of Maotai Liquor.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a double shares coupon.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 51% of Yi Ke Real Estate’s shares.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 51% of Wansheng Group’s shares.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Agreement Hospital.]

….

With 200,000 red packets, Lin Fan received a total of 21,049,801 yuan.

He also got a one yuan critical hit card, which meant that if he spent one yuan, Lin Fan could get one billion yuan.

The market value of Maotai Liquor exceeded two trillion yuan. 10% of the shares would be 200 billion yuan!

Lin Fan used the two double shares coupons on Little Tanuki and Penguin.

Originally, Lin Fan held 40% of the shares of the Ah-Ri Corporation and Penguin Corporation. After doubling them, they became 80%!

In other words, his shares in the two companies instantly increased by 40%!

One had to know…

The market value of Little Tanuki and Penguin both exceeded five trillion!

That meant he owned a cumulative total of four trillion!

Yi Ke Real Estate was the largest real estate company in Hua Nation, with a market value of about 200 billion. 51% of the shares meant 100 billion.

Wansheng Group was one of the top food and beverage companies in the world. Its market value was about 200 billion, and 51% of its shares were also 100 billion.

Agreement Hospital was the largest private hospital in Hua Nation, with an estimated market value of more than 100 billion!

…

All of these were from Lin Fan opening 200,000 red packets. The total value was close to five trillion yuan!

These 200,000 red packets were all from Lin Fan spending two billion to buy a toy factory!

What did it feel like to spend two billion and earn five trillion?

Lin Fan was the one experiencing it!

He looked at the red packets on the screen and could not help but smile.

After a while, he collected his thoughts and drove the Cullinan away.

…

In the Dongcheng area of Jiangbei, in a beautiful location.

Last year, the Jiangbei government invested three billion yuan here to build a sizable office building and factory.

Originally, they were prepared to invite investment from the government.

For this… they even made a public announcement and made several advertisements.

Some companies also expressed their willingness.

However, just a few days ago, the investment promotion work came to an abrupt end.

This was because the office building and factory area had been taken over by the Institute of Science.

At this moment, Feng Zhixiang, several academicians, and many staff members stood in front of the entrance of the Institute of Science. They waited quietly.

Just as everyone was looking ahead…

A tall and sturdy car drove over.

It was Lin Fan’s Cullinan.

Lin Fan also saw Feng Zhixiang and the others standing at the entrance. He slowly stopped the car.

Feng Zhixiang welcomed him with a smile and said, “Professor Lin, welcome to the Jiangbei branch of the Institute of Science!”

Even though Feng Zhixiang had already told everyone that Lin Fan was very young, the academicians were still surprised when they saw him.

He was simply too young.

Who would have thought that it was such a young man who had solved several world-class mathematics problems, invented the earthquake prediction device, super battery, carbon-based photolithographic machine, human islet recovery drug, gaming helmet, artificial limbs, and so on? He had achieved a series of things that shocked the world!

The academicians were stunned for a moment before they said, “Professor Lin, welcome to the Jiangbei branch of the Institute of Science.”

Lin Fan said, “You didn’t have to wait at the door.”

Feng Zhixiang said, “You’ve made such a great contribution to the academic world, and even to the entire world. What’s the big deal if we just wait at the door? This is what we should do.”

All the academicians nodded.

Obviously, they agreed with him.

Then, Lin Fan walked in with Feng Zhixiang and the other academicians.

After a while, they arrived at the laboratory where the carbon-based photolithographic machine was displayed.

An academician wearing gold-rimmed glasses finally could not help but say, “Professor Lin, may I ask you some questions?”

Lin Fan nodded and said, “Sure.”

After all, the reason he came here was to answer their questions.

The academician with gold-rimmed glasses quickly said, “Professor Lin, how did you make the purity of carbon nanotubes reach 99.9999999%?”

Lin Fan replied, “High electromagnetic purification…”

The gold-rimmed glasses academician’s cloudy eyes lit up slightly, and a look of realization appeared on his face.

The other academicians nodded.

Then, they quickly asked the questions that they had been puzzled about.

Lin Fan did not keep secrets from them and gave them detailed answers.

Every time, Lin Fan did not just answer the questions.

He also explained all the knowledge related to the problem, and the academicians were fascinated.

At first, when they saw Lin Fan’s young appearance, they were shocked.

At this moment, their gazes toward Lin Fan were filled with respect and admiration!

They looked like outstanding students who had met a knowledgeable teacher.

One had to know… these were the top scientists in the country and even the world!

Every single one of them stood out in the industry, and they were all figures of great stature.

Now, they were treating a young man in his 20s as their teacher.

If word of this got out, who knew how many people’s jaws would drop?
